jobs.title: Senior Manager DevOps Engineering
jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering is a hands-on engineering leader accountable for the strategy, design, delivery, and operational maturity of secure cloud platforms and software delivery capabilities supporting Claims Global Claims Operations (GCO). This leader will manage and develop a team of DevOps, platform, and site reliability engineers while partnering with application, data, AI/ML, architecture, security, and product teams.

The role will establish standardized CI/CD, Infrastructure-as-Code, cloud governance, observability, reliability, and DevSecOps practices that accelerate delivery while maintaining the controls required for healthcare and other regulated workloads. The successful candidate will combine strong people leadership with deep technical judgment, measurable operational ownership, and the ability to influence across a complex enterprise.

Leadership mandate: Build a reliable, secure, reusable engineering platform that improves developer velocity, production resilience, and governance by design.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* People Leadership & Engineering Management

  + Own workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, and skills development aligned to the platform roadmap
  + Create an inclusive, high-performing engineering culture grounded in ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and blameless improvement
  + Translate business priorities into an executable roadmap, capacity plan, delivery milestones, and measurable engineering outcomes
* DevOps Platform Strategy & Delivery
  + Define and execute the DevOps and platform engineering strategy for cloud-native applications, data products, and AI-enabled solutions
  + Build and govern reusable "paved-road" capabilities including source control standards, build automation, artifact management, deployment pipelines, environment provisioning, configuration management, and release orchestration
  + Establish standardized CI/CD patterns for application, infrastructure, data, and AI/ML workloads, with automated quality gates and promotion controls
  + Drive platform adoption through strong documentation, self-service workflows, developer enablement, office hours, and actionable product telemetry
* Cloud Infrastructure & Automation
  + Lead the design and operation of secure, scalable, and cost-efficient AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code and policy-as-code practices
  + Establish reusable Terraform modules and cloud deployment patterns covering networking, compute, containers, serverless, storage, databases, identity, secrets, logging, and monitoring
  + Guide container orchestration and runtime engineering using Kubernetes/EKS and related cloud-native technologies where appropriate
  + Partner with architecture, cloud, security, and FinOps teams to improve cloud governance, capacity management, resilience, and cost transparency
* DevSecOps, Risk & Compliance

  + Implement role-based access, segregation of duties, audit evidence, traceability, and policy enforcement consistent with enterprise and regulated-environment requirements
  + Partner with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and audit teams to remediate findings and maintain production-readiness controls
  + Ensure platform capabilities protect sensitive healthcare data and support applicable privacy, retention, and access-control expectations
* Site Reliability & Operational Excellence
  + Define service-level objectives, reliability indicators, error budgets, operational dashboards, and production health standards for critical services
  + Advance end-to-end observability through metrics, logs, traces, synthetic monitoring, alerting, and service health telemetry
  + Lead incident response and problem management practices, including command structure, stakeholder communication, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and learning reviews
  + Drive resilience engineering through high availability, backup and recovery, disaster recovery, capacity planning, performance engineering, and game-day exercises
* AI/ML and Data Delivery Enablement
  + Enable secure delivery patterns for AI/ML and generative AI workloads, including model and prompt configuration promotion, evaluation gates, lineage, observability, rollback, and controlled release
  + Partner with data and AI engineering teams to establish MLOps, LLMOps, and DataOps integration points without duplicating domain-team ownership

* Enterprise Collaboration & Executive Communication

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager (User Acquisition & Lifecycle)
jobs.description:
**Growth Marketing Manager (User Acquisition & Lifecycle)**

**Spiceworks | Cloud Help Desk & Inventory Online**

**The Opportunity**

Spiceworks has been an industry pillar for more than 15 years, cultivating a community of millions of IT

professionals. Its flagship IT Helpdesk product, now Cloud Help Desk (CHD), has evolved from a completely free,

ad-supported solution to a freemium, subscription-based model designed to provide users with an ad-free

experience and additional premium features.

We are looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Manager to own user acquisition and lifecycle execution across

Cloud Help Desk and Inventory Online. This is a high-drive individual contributor role for someone who enjoys

building, launching, testing, and optimizing growth programs directly. You will be responsible for increasing user

acquisition, reactivating lapsed users, engaging active free users, and helping convert qualified users into premium

subscribers.

You will work closely with Product Management, Community, and internal product experts. While product experts

will support deep technical demonstrations and product knowledge, you will own the growth engine—from audience

segmentation and campaign execution through engagement, conversion, and performance measurement.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Database Reactivation & Win-Back Funnels: Build, write, launch, and optimize targeted reactivation email

campaigns for historical and lapsed users. Develop messaging that communicates the value of the modernized,

ad-free product experience, ease of setup, workflow efficiency, and minimal operational disruption.

* Product-Led Growth (PLG) & Lifecycle Marketing: Build and manage automated lifecycle campaigns triggered by

user behavior and product-usage milestones. Own the user journey from free sign-up or trial through

engagement, activation, and premium conversion.

* Campaign Development & Optimization: Create segmented, targeted, and multi-channel campaigns using

lifecycle marketing platforms such as HubSpot, Intercom, Marketo, or similar tools. Test messaging, audiences,

timing, and conversion paths to improve acquisition and subscription outcomes.

* Field Marketing, Local Meetups & Roadshows: Plan, coordinate, and host localized user meetups, workshops,

and roadshows designed to re-engage free and lapsed users. Work with existing Spiceworks community

chapters to build local participation and create meaningful user interactions.

* Event-Led Acquisition: Partner with internal product experts to deliver engaging user sessions, ensuring

technical product demonstrations are complemented by clear value messaging and a defined digital conversion

journey.

* Community & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with the Community Manager to understand forum

sentiment, identify opportunities within the community, and turn relevant discussions and engagement into

acquisition opportunities.

* Performance & Insights: Track acquisition velocity, engagement, reactivation, free-to-paid conversion, and

campaign performance. Use data and event feedback to identify opportunities, improve campaigns, and provide

actionable insights to Product Management.

* End-to-End Ownership: Take personal ownership of growth initiatives from audience selection and campaign

creation through launch, measurement, optimization, and reporting.

**Job Qualifications**

**Required Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:**

* 2–5 years of hands-on experience in B2B SaaS growth marketing, user acquisition, lifecycle marketing, product-

led growth, or a closely related discipline.

* Demonstrated experience building and executing automated lifecycle campaigns using tools such as HubSpot,

Intercom, Marketo, or similar marketing automation platforms.

* Hands-on experience with user segmentation, behavioral targeting, email journeys, conversion funnels, and

campaign optimization.

* Experience organizing and executing community events, user meetups, workshops, roadshows, or other field

marketing initiatives.

* Strong growth-oriented copywriting skills, with the ability to translate product capabilities and updates into clear,

compelling user benefits.

* Strong analytical mindset with comfort working with user data, acquisition metrics, conversion rates, campaign

performance, and growth targets.

* Ability to work independently, move quickly, experiment, learn from results, and take ownership of execution.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly when partnering with Product,

Community, and technical subject-matter experts.

Required Education and/or Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in a SaaS, technology, IT, developer, workflow, or digital product environment is preferred.
* Experience working with a freemium or product-led growth model is strongly preferred.

**About Spiceworks:**

Spiceworks is a technology-focused community and software business serving IT professionals. Its community

brings together IT professionals and technology decision-makers, while its software products help businesses

manage essential IT workflows. The Cloud Help Desk and Inventory Online products are designed to support IT

teams with practical tools for managing their day-to-day technology operations.

As part of Ziff Davis, Spiceworks operates within a portfolio of leading brands across technology, shopping,

entertainment, health and wellness, cybersecurity, and marketing technology. This role offers the opportunity to

jobs.title: Systems Development Engineer II, FO Support
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon.com is seeking a Systems Development Engineer to join a Fulfillment Optimization team that helps promise, plan, and execute the delivery of millions of packages to customers worldwide — faster and cheaper each day — while providing an extraordinary customer experience from the website to doorstep delivery. Our systems handle millions of requests per second and make business recommendations that impact billions of dollars each year. With rapid expansion into new geographies, increasing complexity of the transportation network, and an expanding selection of products, the Fulfillment Optimization team builds solutions that scale and propel the business with best-in-class technology innovations.  
  
We are looking for passionate, hard-working, and talented engineers who have experience supporting innovative, mission-critical, high-volume applications — and who are excited to apply AI and agentic automation to how large-scale systems are supported and operated. You will have an enormous opportunity to work across multiple systems: researching and identifying common issues, building AI-powered tooling that diagnoses and prevents them, and driving teams toward resolution to have a positive impact on the customer experience. Your solutions will impact our customers directly. This role requires you to hit the ground running; your ability to learn quickly and work on disparate and overlapping tasks will define your success.  
  
The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, has superior verbal and written communication skills and strong organizational skills, can juggle multiple tasks at once, works independently, and maintains professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. Your ability to accurately prioritize work, make sound technical trade-offs, improve the customer experience, and get the right things done will have a direct impact on Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization and fulfillment-network efficiency.  
  
As a SysDE II on this team, you will work autonomously on difficult, team- and component-level problems, build resilient and well-tested solutions, and increasingly act as a force multiplier — enabling other builders through the tools, automation, and AI capabilities you deliver.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Dive deeply into technical details to diagnose, reproduce, and root-cause issues across Amazon technology products (services, tools, data solutions, etc.), and drive them to resolution or escalation.
* Design, build, and operate AI-powered and agentic support capabilities — diagnostic agents, automated root-cause analysis, anomaly detection, and self-healing/auto-remediation — that detect and prevent issues before they impact customers.
* Apply AI across the software development lifecycle (spec-driven and AI-assisted development, agentic workflows) to raise engineering velocity and quality.
* Automate repetitive operational tasks to increase efficiency and reduce manual toil, and build tooling that enables other engineers.
* Manage trouble tickets through to resolution or escalation using existing documentation, procedures, and tools, and improve those mechanisms over time.
* Use technology to monitor security vulnerabilities and eliminate risk; identify and mitigate reliability risks at the team and component level.
* Improve service resilience, performance, and operational metrics; define and apply operational-excellence practices for the team.
* Participate in a team on-call rotation, providing operational support for the services the team owns.
* Collaborate with partner teams, Technical Program Managers, and Product Managers to deliver on shared goals.
* Work in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology.

  
About the team  
The Fulfillment Optimization (FO) Support team plays a crucial role in Amazon's supply chain operations. We invent and deliver software solutions that facilitate Customer Promise Speed, Order Planning, and Fulfillment.  
  
The FO Support team leverages data, process improvement, and innovative technologies — including AI and agentic automation — to provide comprehensive engineering-excellence services and solutions across FO's product portfolios. The team is responsible for FO services as front-line support and plays a central role in the organization's success.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
* Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large-scale infrastructure

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience building services using AWS products
* Experience with distributed systems at scale
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience leveraging AI (Artificial Intelligence) agents for security review automation, spec-driven development practices, or adversarial red teaming
* Experience building or integrating AI/GenAI-powered solutions (e.g., LLM-based tools, agentic frameworks, automated diagnostics or remediation)
* Ability to work independently and solve problems using knowledge of an object-oriented programming language

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Product Manager / Sr. Product Manager - Mulesoft
(Agentic) Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About This Role**
We are building a durable execution process engine – a platform that bridges enterprise workflow automation and intelligent agent orchestration. This is a zero-to-one product launch from concept to market.
  
  
You will lead the product strategy and execution for one of three interconnected pillars in the platform (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents). Working alongside peer PMs and reporting to the Group PM, you'll own the complete customer journey: from defining what we build, to shipping it, to ensuring it lands with users.
  
  
This role is for a PM who has shipped complex, multi-layer platform products before and who thrives in the tension between technical ambition and customer reality.
  
  
**The Product Vision**
A durable execution engine that scales from developer laptops to enterprise clouds, bringing workflow automation, intelligent agents, and real-time data integration into one coherent platform.
  
  
Modern enterprises are stuck. Legacy workflow systems are rigid and don't integrate with AI. Code-first pipelines (Airflow, Temporal) give developers freedom but leave business analysts behind. We're building the bridge.
  
  
**Our Platform Will**

* Work for multiple personas – Business analysts author visually, engineers deploy as code, operators observe in real time. No translation layer needed.
* Treat AI as native – Intelligent agents aren't bolted on; they're first-class actors in the process execution model with full auditability and compliance guardrails.
* Connect everything – Data from any source (APIs, databases, message queues, cloud services) flows naturally through your processes without custom plumbing.
* Build toward Horizon's sophistication – Our long-term ambition is to deliver agentic orchestration depth comparable to the best-in-class products in the market.

The result: enterprises can automate complex work faster, with more control, and with confidence that their processes will execute reliably at scale.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
Strategic ownership
  
  

* Define the product roadmap for Workflows & Orchestration – what customers need, what moves the needle, what builds defensible value
* Make the hard calls: what ships in MVP, what is post-launch, what never ships
* Own the competitive positioning – position durable processes as a first-class pillar of an integrated platform, not a standalone point solution
* Shape both pro-code and no-code experiences – own SDKs, CLI, and visual editor consistency; documentation and learning paths across both personas

Execution leadership
  
  

* Lead cross-functional alignment (eng, design, marketing, sales) on priorities and milestones
* Conduct customer discovery: who are we building for, what problems do they have, what's blocking adoption
* Make data-driven decisions: usage patterns, customer feedback, performance metrics all inform direction
* Unblock ambiguity: when technical direction isn't clear, you synthesize information and move forward decisively

Partnership with peer PMs
  
  

* You're not alone – work collaboratively with two peer IC PMs who own the Data Connectors and AI Agents pillars
* Establish clear integration points and contract boundaries so all three pillars (Durable Processes, Data Connectors, AI Agents) work together seamlessly
* Escalate only real conflicts up to the Group PM; resolve most decisions at your level

**We're Looking For**
**Experience Shipping One Or More Of The Following**
Complex infrastructure or platform products
  
  

* Enterprise workflow or automation systems
* Products that span multiple user personas (business analysts, developers, operators)
* Products that required deep technical integration
* Zero-to-one launches where you shaped initial product-market fit.

Core capabilities
  
  

* Technical fluency – You read code, understand architecture constraints, and can have a real conversation with engineers about feasibility and tradeoffs. You don't need to be an engineer, but you think like one.
* Customer obsession with realism – You spend time with users, but you're not a feature-request transcriber. You synthesize what they need from what they say.
* Decisiveness under ambiguity – You make calls with incomplete information. You're comfortable killing ideas you love if data suggests they won't work.
* Communication across layers – You talk to engineers about latency budgets, to customers about compliance, to executives about roadmap priorities. Different audiences, same honesty.
* Systems thinking – You see how pieces connect. Developer SDKs influence adoption patterns. Pricing models influence feature prioritization. You optimize for the system, not the local maximum.
* AI native – You’re using LLMs as part of your product workflow and can adapt to any tool easily. We currently use Claude Code and Cursor.

Nice to have
  
  

* 5+ years of relevant experience as a Product Manager, with a strong focus on platform products.
* Exposure to workflow engines, BPM systems, or process orchestration platforms (Camunda, Zeebe, Airflow, Temporal).
* Experience with enterprise compliance requirements (SOC 2, PCI-DSS, HIPAA) and how they shape product architecture.
* Understanding of multi-tenant SaaS scaling challenges and tradeoffs
* Previous zero-to-one product launch where you defined the initial MVP and shaped early-stage product-market fit.
* Experience building features using LLMs (it can be a hobby project).

We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Principal Digital Solutions Engineer
  
  
About Lilly
  
  
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it's work worth doing. If you're driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Manufacturing & Quality Technical Hub, Hyderabad
  
  
Lilly's Hyderabad hub is a first-of-its-kind technical center built to lead the manufacturing and quality science agenda for Lilly's global supply network, and the work done here reaches patients in more than 110 countries.
  
This hub oversees contract manufacturing of starting materials and intermediates for API manufacturing in India, managing the full scientific agenda for manufacturing and quality. We're building a cutting-edge scientific organization and looking for top talent in process engineering, chemistry, analytical and data sciences to be part of it.
  
The science you develop here doesn't stay here. It moves through Lilly's global supply network and reaches patients across more than 110 countries who are counting on it.
  
  
Digital Manufacturing Engineering (DME) is part of the Corporate Engineering Tech Center (ETC). The ETC is a technical resource for training, standards, project implementation, and the center of engineering excellence for the corporation, providing deeply technical resources to solve the most intractable technical problems in manufacturing. DME provides Digital Engineering Platform ownership, OT data integration solutions, engineering data standardization/ownership, and digital manufacturing solutions for Lilly Manufacturing. Our team focuses on connecting our facilities (securely) and leveraging the data from those facilities to deliver digital manufacturing solutions to improve manufacturing productivity, data integrity / compliance, quality, and operational excellence. Digital Manufacturing Technologies include digital twins, computational modeling, edge/IoT, and analytics solutions. Digital Engineering Platforms include CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System), GECMS (Global Engineering Content Management System) and many other digital platforms leveraged by engineers across Lilly Manufacturing.
  
  
Position Description and Responsibilities
  
  
The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer will design, develop, support, and continuously enhance digital solutions across Lilly's global manufacturing network, while serving as the owner for one or more digital products developed by the DME team. Representative solutions in scope span the four pillars of the Engineering Digital Strategy and include — but are not limited to — the Intralogistics Monitor (ILM), Audit Trail solutions, Condition-Based Maintenance solutions, RCA and troubleshooting solutions, equipment health and predictive maintenance dashboards, capital project and qualification workflow tools, engineering knowledge search, and inspection-readiness data products. These solutions are developed on standard Digital Engineering Platforms supported by the DME team, and the engineer will partner with data leads to ensure the necessary IT, OT, and ET data is available to support each solution. The engineer is also expected to leverage AI tools and platforms — such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot, and Anthropic's Claude — to accelerate development and to embed AI capability into solutions, including building agent skills, prompt-based workflows, and retrieval/automation patterns on top of existing Lilly-approved AI platforms. This role is not focused on training or developing foundation models; it is focused on applying AI tools effectively and responsibly to manufacturing problems. This is a global role, supporting functional initiatives and all Lilly Manufacturing sites globally.
  
This role operates within an evolved Digital Solutions Engineering operating model. The team includes a Rapid Innovation branch that works at speed to prototype concepts and proof-of-value solutions against key business problems surfaced from the manufacturing network. The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer takes ownership of those solutions once they have been validated as worth scaling — maturing them from prototype to production-grade, hardening them for validated-system and data-integrity requirements, deploying and supporting them across sites, and providing long-term ownership over their roadmap, enhancement, and lifecycle. This split lets the Rapid Innovation branch stay focused on speed and discovery while the Principal Digital Solutions Engineer ensures that the most valuable concepts become durable, well-supported solutions that scale across the global manufacturing network.

Serve as a principal architect within the capital markets technology group shaping scalable hybrid solutions based on Core Java and a leading COTS product for derivatives processing. Design and optimize Calypso based back office workflows APIs and extensions that improve operational accuracy reduce settlement risk and help deliver resilient trading and post trade platforms for global clients.

* Bring proven experience in capital markets technology with hands on exposure to at least one major COTS trading or risk product and solid understanding of trade life cycle concepts
* Demonstrate strong expertise in Core Java including multithreading memory management and integration frameworks applied to high volume post trade processing solutions
* Show in depth working knowledge of Calypso configuration APIs and extension mechanisms covering trade workflows task stations scheduled tasks and messaging interfaces
* Exhibit practical experience with Calypso back office operations including settlements confirmations collateral reconciliation and investigation processes in a production setting

* Utilize familiarity with continuous integration and continuous delivery practices code quality tools and automated testing to support reliable and repeatable Calypso release cycles

About PURE Energy

PURE Energy makes all-in-one energy storage products for Indian homes and businesses under the PuREPower brand, and it runs the PURE EV electric vehicle business. Our day-to-day operations run on software we build ourselves. Four in-house platforms cover customer leads, dealer operations, finance and HR, and the MIS team keeps them running and improving.

About the role

The MIS Assistant is a hands-on builder, not only a spreadsheet owner. You will work directly with the CEO and the MIS team to maintain and extend our in-house platforms. As you grow into the role, you will design and front-end new modules on your own, once the business requirements are clear.

Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Functions and Hosting), BigQuery, GCP, Hands-on JavaScript (Node.js or browser JavaScript) and Python, Claude Cowork and Claude Code are your everyday development partners, and the company provides that access.

This role suits someone who wants to build real business software within weeks or quicker, learn how a manufacturing operations and sales business runs from the inside, and take full ownership of what they ship.

What you will do

● **Maintain and improve the four platforms:** Fix bugs, take change requests from the CEO and department heads, and ship enhancements safely on Firebase (Firestore, Cloud Functions and Hosting).

● **Build new modules end to end:** Turn a business process into a working module, including its data model, access rules and front-end screens. The CEO or MIS lead signs off the scope and the design.

● **Automate reports and data flows:** Build dashboards and reports in BigQuery and Apps Script, and automate scheduled jobs, bank and accounting feeds, and webhooks such as lead capture and WhatsApp or email notifications.

● **Use AI-assisted development with care:** Use Claude Cowork and Claude Code to design, write, test and document code faster, and review every AI-generated change before it reaches a user.

● **Protect data integrity:** Run reconciliations and data-quality checks, such as comparing a screen against its source data, clean legacy records, and flag discrepancies before they reach reports.

● **Support teams and document the work:** Resolve day-to-day issues raised by sales, service, finance and HR, and keep runbooks, release notes and user guides current.

● **Build and tune AI features:** Help develop the voice agents (ElevenLabs), LLM prompts (Claude, Gemini) and AI-assisted workflows that the business depends on.

What we are looking forMust have

● Zero to two years of experience in software development, MIS or another technical role, or a portfolio of projects you built and shipped yourself.

● A B.E./B.Tech, BCA, MCA or equivalent degree, or a strong self-taught portfolio that shows real builds.

● Hands-on JavaScript (Node.js or browser JavaScript) and/or Python, with the ability to read, write, debug and explain code.

● Front-end basics in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, so that you can build screens for new modules on your own.

● Familiarity with a cloud database such as Firestore, plus REST APIs and webhooks.

● Working knowledge of Git and GitHub (branches, commits and pull requests), and basic SQL.

● Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, Gemini or ChatGPT to build things, with clear prompting and critical review of the output.

● Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain a technical problem to a non-technical colleague.

Must to have

● A deployed Firebase or Google Cloud project, or an automation that a real team uses every week.

● Experience with React or a similar front-end framework.

● Experience with BigQuery, Hands-on JavaScript (Node.js or browser JavaScript) and Python.

● Experience with voice or chat AI agents (for example ElevenLabs) or with the WhatsApp/META Business API.

● Exposure to real-time workflows of business operations.

How you work

● **Genuine drive:** You enjoy building software that people in the company use every day, and you keep improving it after the first version works.

● **Context first:** You take time to understand how sales, service, finance or HR actually work before you build for them, and you ask good questions early.

● **Ownership:** You take a request from idea to a tested, deployed and documented result, and you follow through when something breaks.

● **Urgency with judgement - Deadline as Yesterday:** You bring real urgency when a release, a dealer deadline or a month-end close needs it, and you plan your time so that quality does not slip.

● **Discretion:** You handle employee, customer and financial data carefully and follow the access rules at all times.

Our platforms

You will work across all four platforms. Over time you should be able to explain how each one works, where its data comes from, and how a change reaches the people who use it.

**Platform**

**What it does today**

**PuREPower CRM**

Captures leads from the website and AI voice calls, routes them to dealers or the in-house sales team, tracks follow-ups and conversions, and provides team, dealer and management dashboards. It runs on Firestore, with BigQuery for deep analysis and an ElevenLabs voice-agent dashboard.

Runs dealer operations across about 46 modules: quotations, sales orders, spares, serial-number inventory, dispatch challans, logistics registers, pre-delivery inspection, site surveys, service tickets, installation and commissioning, dealer training and dealer statements.

jobs.description:
The Director – Master Data Management will lead the Finance GBS master data capability from Hyderabad. The role is accountable for setting the strategic direction, governance framework, operating model, control environment and data quality agenda for Finance GBS master data while staying aligned to overall Enterprise MDM strategy. The Director will partner with global process owners, tower leads, Finance leadership, IT, compliance and audit teams to improve master data accuracy, strengthen controls, reduce downstream process issues and enable scalable service delivery across Finance GBS.

  

**MDM Strategy and Governance**

* Own the Finance GBS master data strategy, roadmap and operating model, covering both in-house and outsourced delivery.
* Establish global policies, standards, controls, ownership and decision rights for Finance master data.
* Provide governance across master data domains, regions and systems, including prioritization, escalation and exception management.
* Align MDM priorities with Finance GBS objectives, global process owners and business requirements.

**Global MDM Operations and Service Delivery**

* Lead the Hyderabad MDM organization and oversee end-to-end master data operations across customer, vendor, material and other applicable Finance data domains.
* Manage both in-house and outsourced delivery through clear accountabilities, service levels, operating routines and performance expectations.
* Ensure consistent execution of master data creation, maintenance, validation and deactivation in accordance with policies, controls and service expectations.
* Build and develop the MDM team, including organization structure, role clarity, capability development, performance management and succession coverage.
* Drive standardization of request intake, approvals, documentation and exception handling across regions and systems.

**Data Quality, Controls and Technology Enablement**

* Own the Finance GBS master data quality and control agenda, including KPIs, monitoring, issue remediation and audit readiness.
* Ensure master data processes comply with internal controls, segregation of duties, regulatory requirements and data governance standards.
* Partner with process owners and IT to address root causes of data issues and strengthen ERP workflows, validation rules, integrations and system controls.
* Represent Finance GBS MDM requirements in ERP changes, system enhancements and broader technology initiatives.

**Transformation and Capability Building**

* Own the MDM improvement roadmap, including process simplification, automation, workflow enhancement, data cleansing and duplicate reduction.
* Use performance data and stakeholder feedback to improve service quality, productivity and control effectiveness.
* Strengthen functional capability through training, documentation, knowledge management and adoption of consistent MDM practices.
* Partner with Finance GBS transformation teams to connect master data improvements with broader process performance and value delivery.

  

**Education / Experience / Expertise**

* Master’s degree in accounting or related field required.
* Data governance, ERP, Six Sigma, PMP or master data management certifications are preferred.
* Experience in global manufacturing, technology, services, or complex multinational environments preferred.

**MDM and Finance Expertise**

* 18+ years of experience across master data management, Finance operations, GBS/shared services or data governance.
* Deep understanding of Finance master data and its impact on PTP, OTC, RTR, financial controls and operational performance.
* Strong knowledge of MDM governance, data quality, ERP-enabled workflows, internal controls and audit requirements.

**Global Operations and Transformation**

* Proven experience leading a global MDM function across multiple regions, business units and ERP environments.
* Experience designing or transforming an MDM operating model, including capability setup, offshore transition and management of in-house and outsourced delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to drive standardization, technology enablement and sustainable process improvement at scale.

**Business and Stakeholder Leadership**

* Strong business acumen, with the ability to translate master data issues into operational, financial, control and customer impact.
* Proven ability to align and influence senior Finance, Operations, IT, Compliance and Audit stakeholders in a global matrix organization.
* Ability to simplify complex issues, establish clear priorities and communicate effectively with executive leadership.

**People and Organizational Leadership**

* Proven experience building and leading high-performing teams, developing leaders and establishing clear accountability.
* Strong track record of managing performance, building functional capability and creating succession depth.
* Executive presence and the ability to lead through ambiguity, organizational change and competing priorities.

jobs.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Basel III Business Analyst – Manager/Senior**
**Description**
EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process & controls.
  
  
Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
  
  
Within FSRM, the CSTC team assists across end-to-end aspects of Capital management, BASEL, credit risk and Stress testing related activities:
  
  

* Key role involves producing critical deliverables to the senior management and regulators including EMEIA, US and APAC entities’ credit risk review, capital projections, Basel 4, Basel 3 endgame, capital aspects of Recovery & Resolution planning (RRP), stress testing and having oversight of various regulatory requirements.
* Consulting and solutions delivery such as impact assessments, defining the target operating model, and integrated risk and finance reporting framework
* Quality assurance such as assessment of controls of the Banking industry and similar business lines covering regulatory reporting involving Basel/CRR/RRP regulations
* Early identification and accurate analysis of prudential developments and influence on changes to the capital framework.
* Regulatory capital impact assessment in legal entity simplification initiatives, business re-organizations, new business initiatives and external commitments to regulators

Clients include large domestic and global financial institutions, broker-dealers, foreign banking organizations, asset management firms with significant capital markets activities. Project teams frequently work with the senior management of these firms, including CFOs and CROs.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The role is for a Basel III Business Analyst supporting the Basel III Proposal Roadmap implementation. The engagement focuses on restarting Basel III Proposal implementation program, adopting the Expanded Risk-Based Approach (ERBA), accelerating Single Counterparty Credit Limits (SCCL) gross exposure measurements, and onboarding incremental Basel III data requirements into the Unified Consumption Layer (UCL) Data Factory. The candidate will support exposure-pod based execution across credit risk, securitization, credit risk mitigation, derivatives / SA-CCR, operational risk, and related regulatory capital workstreams. The role requires strong business analysis, regulatory capital, data sourcing, data profiling, source-to-target mapping, calculation logic documentation, Axiom input mapping, controls design, testing, governance, and stakeholder management capabilities. The candidate will work closely with Risk, Finance, Technology, Data, Operations, and business stakeholders to produce implementation-ready requirements, support interim ERBA calculator development, and enable transparent program execution through high-quality documentation, testing, and governance routines.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support detailed implementation planning, governance, project management, status reporting, RAID / action trackers, decision logs, and senior stakeholder updates for the B3P Roadmap.
* Refresh the Basel III Proposal / ERBA gap assessment and identify new, modified, or enhanced data elements required for rule interpretation, regulatory capital calculations, and downstream reporting.
* Perform data profiling and fit-for-use analysis across existing UCL data elements and source-system data, including review of missing values, syntax consistency, data completeness, appropriateness for regulatory requirements, and data quality issues.
* Document data sourcing, transformation, derivation, and calculation logic requirements for ERBA exposure types including residential mortgage / MSR, CRE, retail, off-balance sheet, corporates, banks, securitization, credit risk mitigation, collateral haircut approach, derivatives / SA-CCR, and operational risk.
* Develop source-to-target mappings, business data dictionaries, data lineage, and transformation specifications to support onboarding of incremental Basel III data requirements into the UCL Data Factory.
* Support UCL Data Factory activities, including data movement logic, UCL data model design, legacy consumption views, UCL ADRS unification, semantic layer configuration inputs, and source-to-target reconciliation / data validation activities.
* Map data elements to Axiom-required calculation inputs and document the business rules, derivations, assumptions, controls, and evidence required to support regulatory capital processing.
* Assist in the design, build, and testing…

jobs.description:
**Description**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Digital & Innovation group at USP is seeking a Business Analyst who can drive and deliver digital tech solutions. We are seeking someone who excels in digital innovation for building impactful data products across our ecosystem.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**The Business Analyst Has The Following Responsibilities**

* Lead large-scale technology programs including scope definition, project planning, prioritization, execution tracking, and successful delivery.
* Create, maintain, and manage detailed project schedules, resource allocations, dependency maps, and technical documentation.
* Conduct readiness assessments across people, processes, systems, and technology components to ensure delivery alignment.
* Develop program baselines, perform gap analyses, drive reviews, and implement updates to ensure strong execution governance.
* Identify, track, and escalate risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies; implement effective mitigation strategies.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather functional and technical requirements, align deliverables, and ensure milestone readiness.
* Prepare comprehensive project artifacts including dashboards, status reports, timelines, risk registers, and delivery plans.
* Facilitate cross-functional meetings, document key decisions, capture action items, and drive closure on follow-ups.
* Monitor project performance, proactively escalate blockers, and ensure timely issue resolution to maintain delivery cadence.
* Partner with engineering, product, operations, and geographically distributed teams to achieve program objectives.
* Provide clear and consistent reporting on KPIs, milestones, risks, and deliverables to leadership and stakeholders.

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Senior Business Systems Analyst**

  

**Experience:** 8-15 Years

  

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Senior Business Systems Analyst with strong General Ledger (GL) and Finance functional expertise to support an enterprise ERP modernization program for a leading insurance organization.

The program involves migrating from PeopleSoft to Workday, supported by an enterprise Data Hub built on Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory (ADF), and ADLS Gen2.

The candidate will analyze existing PeopleSoft SQL and SQR extracts, understand the underlying business logic, and define how Finance data and downstream reporting requirements will be supported in the future-state architecture using Workday and the enterprise Data Hub.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyze existing PeopleSoft SQL queries, SQR programs, extracts, and downstream data flows.
* Understand and document General Ledger, financial close, reconciliation, reporting, and financial control requirements.
* Translate current-state business logic into future-state functional specifications.
* Prepare source-to-target mapping documents, transformation rules, data definitions, and field-level specifications.
* Independently read, analyze, and write SQL queries to validate data, investigate discrepancies, and understand existing data logic.
* Collaborate with Finance stakeholders, Workday functional consultants, and Azure Data Engineering teams.
* Define data validation, reconciliation, completeness, and accuracy requirements.
* Document data lineage, business rules, dependencies, and downstream consumer requirements.
* Support Finance implementation and establish documentation standards for subsequent Actuarial, Investment, Reinsurance, and Risk phases.

  

**Mandatory Skills**

* 8-15 years of relevant experience in Business Systems Analysis, Business Analysis, or Finance Systems.
* Strong functional knowledge of General Ledger and Finance processes.
* Hands-on SQL skills, including the ability to analyze existing queries and develop queries independently.
* Experience analyzing PeopleSoft SQL extracts, SQR programs, or legacy ERP data flows.
* Expertise in functional specifications, source-to-target mapping, and data transformation requirements.
* Experience with ERP modernization, data migration, financial reporting, or enterprise system integration.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work across business and technical teams.

  

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Workday Financial Management / Workday General Ledger.
* Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, and ADLS Gen2.
* Insurance or financial services domain experience.
* Experience with enterprise data hubs and downstream reporting integrations.

  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a hands-on Finance Business Systems Analyst who understands General Ledger processes, can independently investigate legacy SQL/SQR logic, and can convert business requirements into detailed specifications that data engineering teams can implement without ambiguity.

This is not a purely requirements-gathering or documentation role. Strong Finance functional expertise and SQL proficiency are essential.

**kAIgentic** is building the intelligence layer for the world's most ambitious enterprises. Headquartered in Singapore with teams in India and Japan, our software platform helps large organizations evolve as fast as technology itself by turning the tacit know-how locked inside their people into safe, governed, AI-powered operations.

The hardest part of enterprise transformation is not strategy. It is execution. Institutional knowledge lives in people's heads, systems are fragmented, and risk tolerance is low. kAIgentic captures how work actually happens, designs better workflows, and runs them inside an intelligence layer that is observable, auditable, and engineered for the most regulated environments on earth. The outcome is an enterprise that continuously improves.

We are backed by SMBC Group as our founding partner and customer zero, and our platform is already being proven inside one of the most complex, regulated operating environments in the world. That means real problems, real data, and real production impact from Day 1.

You will own one significant part of our product estate end to end: strategy, requirements, delivery and adoption. You will also be kAIgentic’s experience lead across the platform. You will set the principles and patterns every product follows, and own the journeys that cross product boundaries.

Our users do hard, regulated work: confirming how a bank process really runs, redesigning it, and deciding what to automate. The job is not to make that work look simple. It is to remove the labour that shouldn’t be there, keep the expert judgment that should, and make human review mean something.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Define the UX vision that maximizes adoption and quantifiable value across the kAIgentic product suite.
* Architect integrated experience roadmaps that reconcile enterprise governance, legacy workflows, and AI capabilities into seamless user journeys.
* Influence senior leadership, customers, and engineering partners to align feature priorities with reduced cognitive load and heightened trust.
* Represent kAIgentic in customer workshops and industry panels, extracting tacit knowledge that refines the product experience.
* Define measurable adoption and impact metrics, linking user behavior to business outcomes and informing iterative improvement.
* Architect the translation of market, regulatory, and workflow insights into clear product briefs and decision criteria.
* Influence the adoption of AI-enhanced design and research tools within product teams, accelerating evidence-based iteration.

### **Own your product area**

* Set strategy, roadmap and requirements. Write the specs engineering builds from, and make the scope calls, including what to cut.
* Run discovery with the people who do the work. These are experts in banking operations, risk and compliance, often in Japan, and often in situations where you cannot observe the work directly.
* Define success measures that tie user behaviour to outcomes and quality, such as effort per confirmed process, rework and review quality, not adoption alone.

### **Lead experience across the platform**

* Set the experience principles and interaction patterns all products follow. These cover how the product shows confidence and uncertainty, when it asks a person for input, and how review and approval work. Hold the bar in design reviews.
* Own the journeys that cross products, so that what a user confirms in one carries cleanly into the next.
* Design human review that auditors and regulators would accept as meaningful, not a rubber stamp, and define how we measure that it is.
* Design for mixed audiences in the same flow: experts who use the product once or twice, and analysts who work in it daily.
* Prototype with AI tools quickly enough to test ideas with users in days, and raise the team’s practice to match.

* Proven expertise delivering UX-focused product strategy for large-enterprise AI solutions, with a track record of driving adoption and measurable value
* Mastery of product discovery and delivery frameworks, including hypothesis-driven research, PRD authoring, and iterative validation.
* Deep knowledge of enterprise workflow analysis, governance models, compliance constraints, and integration patterns.
* Expertise in AI research fundamentals and the ability to translate model capabilities into user-centric features.
* Strong capability in designing and evaluating user experiences that reduce cognitive load, clarify intent, and build trust.
* Skilled at synthesizing market, regulatory, and customer insights into concise product briefs and strategic direction.
* Exceptional judgment in balancing technical feasibility, security, and scalability with user value.
* Clear, persuasive communication with senior stakeholders, engineering, and customers, both in writing and presentations.
* A track record of owning both a product and its experience in enterprise software used for complex, high-stakes work.
* Judgment to separate essential complexity from accidental complexity. You can show where you removed work and where you deliberately kept it.
* Experience designing oversight of AI or automated decisions, including how model uncertainty and failure reach the user.
* Strong skill at eliciting knowledge from domain experts. Experience in a regulated industry, with banking preferred.

* Influence without authority across product managers, engineering and global stakeholders. Experience with Japanese enterprise clients is a plus.

Ambinix Ventures Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced, target-driven, and strategic Sales Manager – EdTech Sales to lead and expand its sales operations in the education technology and professional training sector.

**Senior UX Designer – AI & Agentic Experiences**
=================================================

**Location:** Bangalore, India (On-site, 5 days a week)

**Employment Type:** Full-time

  

**Design for a World in Motion**
--------------------------------

  

At Maersk, we are transforming global trade through technology, data, and design. As we evolve from a logistics company into a technology-enabled logistics integrator, software and digital experiences play a critical role in creating value for both our customers and our business.

Design at Maersk goes beyond interfaces and interaction patterns. We are increasingly creating connected, AI-enabled experiences that span complex end-to-end journeys. This shift requires designers who can think beyond screens, embrace ambiguity, and leverage AI throughout the design process to understand problems faster, explore solutions more broadly, and validate ideas earlier.

  

We are looking for a proactive, AI-first Senior UX Designer to help shape the future of operational experiences that support the movement of goods around the world.

  

**About the Role**
------------------

  

In this role, you will design the products, workflows, and intelligent experiences that operational teams rely on to deliver transportation services at a global scale. From shipment planning to issue resolution, your work will enable seamless collaboration between users and AI-powered systems across the logistics journey.

  

You will join the **Ocean Transportation Experience Design Team** , a key part of Maersk Experience Design. Our vision is to transform a landscape of disconnected applications into a unified, AI-enabled operational ecosystem that reduces complexity, eliminates friction, and improves efficiency for users worldwide.

This is an opportunity to help define how AI and human expertise work together in one of the world's most complex industries.

  

**Why Join Maersk?**
--------------------

Joining Maersk means becoming part of a purpose-driven organization where technology, design, and innovation are shaping the future of global trade.

As part of our UX community, you will:

* Contribute to meaningful change in one of the world's most essential industries.
* Help build a unified, AI-enabled ecosystem for the people who move cargo around the globe.
* Work at the forefront of AI-powered design practices and emerging technologies.
* Influence strategic decisions through design leadership and customer-centered thinking.
* Collaborate within a diverse, global design community that values autonomy, innovation, and continuous learning.
Access shared design capabilities, including our design system, AI design principles, research practices, and customer insight frameworks.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**

You will:

* Design complete end-to-end experiences across one or more products.
* Define how users and AI systems interact through seamless, intuitive workflows.

* Design experience journeys that intelligently combine interfaces, AI agents, and automation.
* Apply AI and agentic design principles as core elements of the design process.
* Conduct user research, usability testing, and rapid validation exercises, including AI-driven experiences.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Product Owners, Engineers, and business stakeholders from discovery through delivery.
* Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, high-fidelity designs, and production-ready specifications.
* Leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate research, ideation, prototyping, and validation.
* Collaborate across Maersk's global design organization to ensure consistency and quality.
Give and receive constructive feedback to continuously elevate design standards.  

  
  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

### **Experience & Expertise**

You likely bring:

* 8+ years of experience in UX Design, Product Design, or UX Research.
* Experience designing enterprise applications or operational tools where efficiency, productivity, and workflow optimization are critical.
* A degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design, Product Design, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating an AI-first approach to design, including examples of how AI enhanced your process and how outputs were evaluated and refined.
* Hands-on experience designing AI-powered experiences such as assistants, copilots, recommendation systems, intelligent automation, or agentic workflows.
* Deep expertise in Figma, design systems, and modern AI-powered design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma Make, Claude, or similar platforms).
* Experience working within agile, iterative product development environments.
* Strong understanding of user-centered design practices, rapid experimentation, user panels, and continuous feedback loops.
Proven ability to collaborate effectively across countries, cultures, and time zones.  

  

### **Communication & Collaboration**

You should possess:

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

The ability to influence product direction through strong storytelling, collaboration, and evidence-based design thinking.

jobs.description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Process Re-engineering - Payments.**

**In this role, you will:**

* International Organization for Standardization 20022 is a market driven mandatory, global payments directive which will migrate all payment messages from existing MT (Message Type) format into the new MX (SWIFT Message Type defined in ISO 20022) format. Additionally, as part of SWIFT International Organization for Standardization 20022 MX (SWIFT - Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication Message Type defined in ISO 20022) migration, party and agent name and address information must comply to structured format by November 2026. Payment messages that do not comply to structured format will be rejected. The scale of the programme covers over 50 sites in which Markets and Securities Services Operations have a presence and over 40 unique systems which generate payments.
* We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to join the International Organization for Standardization Data workstream in delivering Structured Name and Address mandate by November 2026. The ideal candidate will have prior experience working on large-scale projects within the payments or settlements domain. This role involves extensive data analysis, requirements gathering and validation, coordinate and facilitate discussions with diverse teams across multiple geographical locations, as well as supporting testing for global rollouts.

* Perform data analysis related to payments, settlement instructions, accounts, and static data. Identify SSI (Standard Settlement Instructions) / static data issue, provide remediation recommendations and/or analysis that helps to identify solutions.
* Gather, validate and document business requirements. Facilitate discussions with relevant teams across multiple geographical locations (e.g. Markets and Securities Services Technology, Markets and Securities Services Operations, Static & Reference Data teams, etc) where necessary and ensure requirements are clearly understood by delivery teams.
* Contribute to project planning and execution and ensure alignment with overall programme plan and objectives. Work with the Test Manager and Subject Matter Experts to co-ordinate the preparation of SIT (Systems Integration Testing) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) test cases.
* Work with Markets and Securities Services technology and Markets and Securities Services Operations to ensure complete and robust testing and go-live approach is supported.
* Work the International Organization for Standardization regional leads and / or Markets and Securities Services Operations to ensure business readiness is complete before go-live.

**To be successful, you will:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree preferred.
* 8+ Years of experience in business analysis and Payments.
* Proven experience as a Business Analyst in the payments or settlements domain, preferably within a large-scale project environment.
* Strong capability in handling and analyzing large datasets with attention to detail. Familiar with Business Analysis & Concepts, Process Related documentation and User Testing.
* Expertise in payments with MT (Message Type) and MX (SWIFT Message Type defined in ISO 20022) International Organization for Standardization 20022 format.

* Proactive and self-starting and able to work autonomously on projects. Strong communicator and excellent at building relationships with peers, stakeholders and delivery teams.

jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**
At Electrolux, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.
  
  
Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute and grow together.
  
  
Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
  
  
**All about the role:**
We are seeking an experienced
**IT Business Analyst – Material Management (SAP MM)**
with
**5–8 years of experience**
to support and enhance procurement, inventory management, and supplier collaboration processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate will act as a bridge between business and IT teams, driving efficient and scalable solutions across the supply chain domain with a focus on
**SAP MM**
and
**SAP Ariba Upstream (Sourcing & Contracts)**
.
  
  
**What you’ll do:**
Supply Chain & Procurement Process Support
  
  

* Act as an IT Business Analyst for SAP MM and procurement-related processes.
* Gather, analyze, and document business requirements and translate them into functional specifications.
* Support and optimize end-to-end Procure-to-Pay (P2P) processes.
* Drive improvements in inventory management and stock optimization.
* Enable and enhance supplier collaboration processes.
* Implement and support SAP Ariba Upstream modules (Sourcing & Contracts).
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Finance, SD, and WM/EWM to ensure seamless process integration.
* Support system enhancements, testing, deployments, and releases.
* Troubleshoot issues and provide ongoing application support to business users.
* Prepare documentation, training materials, and support user adoption.

Stakeholder Management & Solution Delivery
  
  

* Partner with business stakeholders to identify process improvement opportunities.
* Translate business needs into scalable SAP solutions.
* Support project delivery activities, including testing, change management, and go-live support.
* Ensure adherence to established IT and business processes.

**Who Are You**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer engineering, Industrial Engineering, MBA, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in Supply Chain IT and procurement solutions.
* Minimum 5 years of end-to-end SAP MM / Inventory Management (IM) implementation and support experience.
* SAP MM / Inventory Management (Intermediate): Hands-on experience implementing and supporting procurement, inventory management, material master, and purchasing processes.
* SAP ECC / SAP S/4HANA (Intermediate): Hands-on experience implementing and supporting MM-related business processes.
* SAP Ariba Upstream – Sourcing & Contracts (Intermediate): Hands-on experience implementing and supporting sourcing and contract management processes in a production environment.
* Procure-to-Pay (P2P) & Procurement Processes (Intermediate): Experience supporting requisitioning, purchasing, supplier collaboration, and contract-driven procurement processes.
* EDI Communication Standards (Intermediate): Understanding of EDI concepts and integrations supporting procurement and supplier transactions.
* Good understanding of supply chain, inventory management, supplier collaboration, and procurement processes.
* Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into functional solutions.
* Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to design innovative technical solutions.
* Good communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* SAP MM or S/4HANA certification.
* Experience implementing or supporting SAP Ariba Upstream (Sourcing & Contracts) in a production environment.
* Familiarity with SAP Fiori applications and digital procurement tools.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
* Experience with supplier lifecycle management and digital procurement transformation initiatives.

**This is a full-time position, based in Bangalore, India.**
**Why work for Electrolux?**

* Build at scale: Lead the development of mission-critical digital commerce experiences used by thousands of customers daily.
* Own the architecture: Influence core technical decisions and help evolve our platform for high scalability, resiliency, and flexibility.
* Modern tech stack: Work with cutting-edge tools in cloud, commerce, and full-stack engineering.
* Empowered leadership: Drive strategy and execution while mentoring a world-class engineering team.
* Growth and impact: Join a high-growth company with a culture that values engineering excellence, innovation, and transparent leadership.

**As part of the Electrolux Group, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you!**
